name: Inbox Manager

workflows.cRe0TSITWFsXVzhS: Allocate inboxes in PlusVibe by tags

may_change: On the sender: a Google or Microsoft inbox's settings back to standards/infrastructure.md inside its jitter range (never the tracking domain or the signature), warmup switched back on, one reconnect try on a disconnected inbox, every running campaign's senders set to the client's active inboxes (never for a two-language client). In the Hub: Domains, Inboxes and Clients rows. Never a kill, a deletion, the active tag, a workspace move or a purchase.
description: Daily 08:00 IL and on demand: reads every client's inboxes on PlusVibe and applies standards/infrastructure.md, inlined from the page at every push. Corrects drift, warmup and disconnections, sets campaign senders to the active inboxes, writes the Hub, posts to #flowroots-infra: emergencies on any day, the full report on Mondays and launched runs, one message per client, plus a client-worded draft for clients with Infra Reports to Client. Corrections run dry, planned and reported only, until LIVE_CORRECTIONS is true in Run Context.
